svg.aria-label: How it works. From a question to work done. 1. The customer calls, writes on the website, or sends a text. 2. The AI agent understands, answers from the business's own information, and collects the details. 3. The systems create and save the order, booking or request. 4. The team gets a short summary by text and email, and follows up. The agent handles the conversation, the systems keep the record, and people stay in control.
